subject.title: Fix stale session routes for removed providers

question: Should OpenClaw ignore persisted session routes whose provider/model is absent from current config/catalog and fall back to the configured default at chat-send time?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but the behavior intentionally changes provider/auth routing for existing persisted sessions, so maintainers need to own the compatibility and data-egress policy tradeoff.

options.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
options.body: Merge the PR once maintainers agree that removed-provider persisted routes should stop routing and resolve to the configured default instead.

options.title: Require stricter stale-route handling
options.body: Ask for diagnostic or fail-closed behavior when catalog loading fails if preserving unknown merge-mode routes is too permissive for provider safety.

options.title: Split persistent cleanup explicitly
options.body: Proceed with the runtime guard only if doctor warnings, session migration, and reset commands are accepted as follow-up work rather than merge scope.

recommendation.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the PR once maintainers agree that removed-provider persisted routes should stop routing and resolve to the configured default instead.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent session model and gateway refactor history and is the best available owner for the compatibility/product boundary decision.
